reviewer: Independent 1.1.0 website release reviewer, Codex agent independent_110
scope: Read-only supplementary review of original browser and AppKit records, official executable identity, retained PNGs, and a private post-exit copy of the dedicated QA SQLite database including WAL. Reviewer did not operate any browser.

edge.browser: Ordinary signed-in Edge, dedicated ChatGPT Temporary Chat
edge.setup: One trusted input entered the fixed draft, then a bounded separate QA command used Selection.setBaseAndExtent to set a backward selection. No file was submitted during preparation.
edge.fixedDraft: Riftlet QA: preserve this original draft while attaching images.
edge.nativeEvidence: The kernel identity and ARM64 code directory matched the signed App. Exactly one mouse selection boundary matched the acknowledged event number and uptime; lease freeze and durable operation consumption shared the same request digest.

sqlite.snapshot: Stable isolated QA DB and WAL copied after App exit, inspected read-only, quick_check ok

edge.identityEvidenceScope: The range observer retained real DOM object references to the document, navigation entry, original form/editor, anchor and focus. Its optional product ID fields were null in both reads. The product target identifiers were verified separately in the operation and START rows and their matching digests.
edge.cleanup: Owned window closed, initial window set and focus restored, isolated App exited. Explicit watcherEnded was false. The owned document was destroyed on closure; the final recorded same-document observation still showed zero send and zero submit.

chrome.scope: The dedicated selected tab showed signed-in/editor/upload signals. The seven bounded foreground samples had the original process and selected tab, all with a protected surface and a different foreground owner.
chrome.earlierPreparation: No product click was issued in the earlier preparation attempts.

safari.scope: No new Safari selection case in this supplement.

matrixAfterSupplement.effect: Edge/ChatGPT already passed the original matrix. This adds a verified real backward selection for that combination. Chrome/ChatGPT retains its other verified cases. All eighteen other providers still lack an authenticated dedicated editable draft. Safari ChatGPT native drag remains partial at browser/provider level.
